review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only C scenario. The original PRD explicitly fixes DEC-001=OPT-1 as hypothetical benchmark input, not a human-confirmed Decision; only that branch is required. Thus ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate for C, while a materially unresolved DEC-001 must still block the paired B scenario at decisions. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, task keys, repository identity/base commit, and the seven evidence stages agree across the specification and Gold. The exact writable scope covers the runtime implementation, maintained public declarations, runtime regressions, and tsd regressions without requiring unnecessary edits or configuration changes. The shared implementation and declaration structure make preserving other exports an explicit compatibility obligation within this scope. TASK-IMPLEMENT and independent TASK-VERIFY, with verification dependent on implementation and both covering every required AC, are consistent with the PRD. The supplied project membership, availability, roles, and active trusted capability claims support the specified eligible agents, including data.change, domain.state, asynchronous integration, and verifier-only testing.verification; pending security.authorization claims are not needed for this feature. An independent active project reviewer is supplied for the earlier risk-review prerequisite. Gold and preview release fingerprints match, and the provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation digest domains and whitespace-only PRD persistence normalization. Historical preparation fields in originalSpecification do not override the later frozen preview inputs. The explicitly truncated test excerpts are sufficient to establish the planning ownership and verification entry points, but are not evidence of test execution or a complete regression audit. No candidate results were used, no code was executed, no human attestation was created, and no digest was independently recomputed; fingerprint binding is accepted as supplied Service evidence.
